name: Interaction with Common Persistence Registry Keys
description: An interaction (create, set, delete, query) was detected with a well-known registry location used for automatic program execution at startup or login. This provides a feature for tracking persistence attempts.

action.description: Interaction detected with a common persistence registry key. SIEM can correlate this with process, file, and network events.

operational_usage: This is a feature-level alert. SIEM should baseline normal software installation behavior and flag interactions from unusual processes (e.g., cmd.exe, powershell.exe, documents in user profiles).
false_positive: Frequent during software installation and updates. The value lies in correlating these events, not treating each one as a standalone threat.
